inlines.v: M'ARGIN, noun [Latin margo.] 1. A border; edge; brink; verge; as the margin of a river or lake. 2. The edge of the leaf or page of a book, left blank or filled with notes. 3. The edge of a wound. 4. In botany, the edge of a leaf. M'ARGIN, verb transitive To furnish with a margin; to border. 1. To enter in the margin
